io.milvus.v2.client

Class RetryConfig

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.client.RetryConfig

  • public class RetryConfig
extends Object
    Configuration for the retry policy applied to Milvus RPC calls.

    Use builder() to create a configuration, then pass it to MilvusClientV2.withRetry(RetryConfig).
